beats.say: Three Emmy awards: Eric Bauza has passed away aged 46.
The BBC reports the Canadian voice artist died from hypertensive cardiovascular disease.
Bauza was the modern voice behind legendary characters like Bugs Bunny and Daffy Duck.
He also voiced Porky Pig, Marvin the Martian and the Toad General in The Super Mario Bros Movie.
Between 2022 and 2025, he won three Emmy awards for his outstanding voice performances.
Born in Ontario and of Filipino descent, he spent his career carrying on the legacy of the world's most famous cartoons.
His sudden loss means the voices of your favourite childhood characters will never sound the same again. Quickplay IRL Clips is here every day, subscribe so you don't miss the next one.
He leaves a legacy of laughter and three Emmy awards.
